title: RSA Algorithm: Theory and Implementation in Python - AskPython
snippet: RSA key generation picks two large primes p and q, computes n = p*q, and derives a public/private key pair from Euler's totient of n. Encryption computes c = m^e mod n; decryption computes m = c^d mod n.

title: RSA Cipher Encryption - TutorialsPoint
snippet: Security relies on the difficulty of factoring the product of two large primes back into its original factors.
